# Project

> How one person runs a project from a problem to its result with the fewest round trips: the scope, the review, the named baseline and the trail, each step a topic, with its grade of evidence and a check on its shape.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension.

## Standard

- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/standard.md): the one-page card to follow, with every principle and its grade
- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository

## Method: from a problem to its result

- [A project is six topics](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/principles/method/a-project-is-six-topics.md): a project is a folder of six parts, problem, scope, review, baseline, plan and trail, each written as a topic.
- [Leave a trail](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/principles/method/leave-a-trail.md): a job leaves what was asked, what was found, what was produced and where it lives, so that a second person can resume it.
- [Name the baseline](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/principles/method/name-the-baseline.md): a review is finished when it names the baseline the result will be compared with, and says how.
- [Specify before building](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/principles/method/specify-before-building.md): a project writes its scope, what is in and what is out and why, before the work starts.

## Optional

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/evidence/README.md): one literature review per topic, with the evidence against
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/evidence/bibliography.md): every cited work, once
- [Shapes](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/shapes/README.md): skeletons for kinds of documents
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics-project/decisions/README.md): the choices this repository made, one record each
